items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: The foundation for genuicn cards: a json-render chat (Fluid Functionalism UI, Vercel AI SDK, AI Gateway) with its API route and a /chat page. Install once, then add cards.
items.docs: Add your Vercel AI Gateway key to .env.local as AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY (Vercel dashboard > AI Gateway > API Keys), then open /chat. Install cards next, e.g. npx shadcn@latest add <site>/r/quote.json.

items.name: quote
items.title: Quote
items.description: A live stock quote card for json-render chats: price, change, a trend line and a 1D/1W/1M/1Y switch, with its API route.
items.docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   QuoteCard: quoteCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: QuoteCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveQuoteCard ticker={props.ticker} range={props.range ?? "1d"} streaming={loading} />

Quotes load from /api/quote (installed at app/api/quote/route.ts). No API key needed.

items.name: weather
items.title: Weather
items.description: A live weather card for json-render chats: temperature, conditions, high and low, and the next six hours on an animated sky drawn for the time of day (dawn, sunrise, day, golden hour, sunset, dusk, night) and the weather (clouds, fog, rain, snow, storms), with its API route.
items.docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   WeatherCard: weatherCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: WeatherCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveWeatherCard location={props.location || undefined} units={props.units} streaming={loading} />

Forecasts load from /api/weather (installed at app/api/weather/route.ts), backed by Open-Meteo. No API key needed.

items.name: flights
items.title: Flights
items.description: A live boarding pass for json-render chats, shaped like a ticket with a tear-off stub: the route over a world map, passenger, cabin and extras, boarding time, terminal, gate, group and seat. Plus a travel assistant that searches and books flights (a route card with searchable cities, a calendar, and results) and checks you in (bags, a seat on a seat map, extras) with Fluid Functionalism's AskUserQuestions (taps and validated short answers, no model needed), then shows the pass. With its API routes and a demo booking to replace with your own.
items.docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   BoardingPass: boardingPassCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: BoardingPass: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveBoardingPassCard flight={props.flight || undefined} date={props.date} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     BoardingPass: boardingPassLookup

Passes load from /api/flights and check-in from /api/flights/check-in (installed under app/api/flights/). Routes come from adsbdb, no API key. Replace getBooking and getSeatMap in features/flights/flight-booking.ts with your booking system.

The check-in assistant (features/flights/components/check-in-agent.tsx) is a standalone page component: render <CheckInAgent className="flex-1" /> in a full-height column. Its conversation is a script in features/flights/check-in-conversation.ts; replace demoBookingOf there with a request to your booking system.

items.name: crypto
items.title: Crypto
items.description: A live crypto price card for json-render chats: price, change, market cap, volume and a trend line with a 24H/1W/1M/1Y/All switch, with its API route and a rate-limit-safe cache in front of CoinGecko and Kraken.
items.docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   CryptoCard: cryptoCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: CryptoCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveCryptoCard symbol={props.symbol || undefined} range={props.range ?? "24h"} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     CryptoCard: cryptoLookup

Prices load from /api/crypto (installed at app/api/crypto/route.ts), backed by CoinGecko's public API, and Kraken's for the All range. No API key needed; the route caches each coin for a minute to stay inside CoinGecko's free rate limit.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: A live area chart for any chartable question in json-render chats: free-text topic, web research via Parallel, latest value, change over the window, a filled trend, and a 10Y/25Y/50Y/Max switch, with its API route.
items.docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   AreaChartCard: areaChartCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: AreaChartCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveAreaChartCard topic={props.topic || undefined} range={props.range ?? undefined} ranges={props.ranges ?? false} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     AreaChartCard: areaChartLookup

Series load from /api/area-chart (installed at app/api/area-chart/route.ts). The route uses Parallel web search + extract (PARALLEL_API_KEY) and your AI Gateway model to turn any chartable topic into a yearly series. Keep AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY set (same as chat). The model sets ranges: true only for long multi-decade series that should show 10Y/25Y/50Y/Max tabs — leave it false/null otherwise. Topic is free text from the user's question.

The route uses Parallel web search + extract (PARALLEL_API_KEY) and your AI Gateway model to turn any comparison into one value per category. Keep AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY set (same as chat). The model sets limit (2–12) for how many bars; null means 8. Topic is free text from the user's question.
